mentions.name: DeepThought
mentions.description: This research project uses LLMs as an "inner monologue" to replicate a thought chain, with dynamically chained thinking steps. It features a 3-layer memory system (a temperature-based Frontbrain of hot context nodes that prevent context overflow, a session-level STM, and a long-term LTS populated at session end), a bitemporal hypergraph of entities and hyperatoms plus linked frame summaries for dynamic graph-traversal retrieval, and an LLM-judged multi-step ingestion pipeline. Currently focused on ingestion and retrieval logic, with planned capabilities for task execution and self-refactoring "thinking primitives" represented as data in the hypergraph.
mentions.problem: Instead of scaling ever-bigger models, it addresses replicating a human-like thought process and preventing context overflow by keeping only currently relevant information in the inference context.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Project: DeepThought

So instead of going for the path to take bigger and bigger models to solve more complex questions, i going another direction. My idea is to use LLM's in a way like an "inner monologue" to replicate a thought chain. Basically create thinking steps that can be dynamically chained.
